It is part of the Ryzen 7 lineup, using the Zen 5 (Granite Ridge) architecture with Socket AM5. Thanks to AMD Simultaneous Multithreading (SMT) each core can process two instruction streams in parallel, making better use of available hardware units, for a total of 16 threads.
